summary: The British arm of German retailer Lidl on Thursday reported a 7% rise in sales over the four-week period before Christmas.

headline: Turkish manufacturing sector nears stabilisation in December, PMI shows
summary: Turkey's manufacturing sector contracted at the slowest rate in eight months in December, a business survey showed on Thursday, in a sign that the sector is nearing stabilisation.

headline: Indonesia's palm oil B40 delay causes market uncertainties
summary: Indonesia has yet to implement a higher mandatory blend of biodiesel planned for Jan. 1 as industry participants await the technical regulations for the rollout, causing confusion among palm oil traders.

headline: Swisscom revises down earnings outlook after Vodafone Italia acquisition complete
summary: Swisscom said on Thursday that it has completed its acquisition of competitor Vodafone Italia, which it will now begin merging with its Italian business Fastweb.

headline: UK plans tough laws to fight people smugglers
summary: Suspected people smugglers will face severe curbs under new laws in Britain, the government said on Thursday, as it steps up efforts to fight illegal migration and strengthen border security.

headline: Fiji police investigating alleged rape, theft of Virgin Australia crew members
summary: Fiji police said on Thursday they were investigating an incident involving two crew members of Australian airline Virgin Australia who were allegedly victims of rape and theft in Nadi in the early hours of New Year's Day.

headline: US Treasury's sanctions office hacked by Chinese government, Washington Post reports
summary: The U.S. Treasury Department's sanctions office was hacked by the Chinese government, the Washington Post reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed officials.

headline: Islamic State claims responsibility for attack on Somalia's Puntland military base
summary: The Islamic State group on Wednesday claimed responsibility for an attack on a military base in Somalia's northeastern region of Puntland a day earlier, the group posted on its Telegram channel.

headline: Next nuclear talks between Iran and three European countries due on Jan 13
summary: The next round of nuclear talks between Iran and three European countries will take place on Jan. 13 in Geneva, Iran's semi-official ISNA news agency cited the country's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi as saying on Wednesday.

headline: Israeli strikes kill at least 17 Palestinians in Gaza, WAFA reports
summary: Israeli air strikes on al-Bureij refugee camp and Jabalia town in central and northern Gaza killed at least 17 Palestinians on Wednesday, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.

headline: Breakaway Moldovan region cuts heating and hot water after Russia stops gas flow
summary: The breakaway Moldovan region of Transdniestria cut heating and hot water supplies to households on Wednesday after Russia stopped supplying gas via Ukraine.
